sanglier.notes: Forêt, niveau 2 : la charge, 1 case. Choix de l'utilisateur (2026-11-09) : sanglier sauvage de la forêt.

mouvements.idle: the wild boar stands on its four legs, snorts, lowers and raises its head, paws the ground with one front hoof, its bristly mane rises a little, the legs stay in place
mouvements.move: the wild boar trots forward to the right with heavy steps in one full trotting cycle, head low, its legs moving in turn, it stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the wild boar lowers its head and lunges forward, thrusting its long tusks upward at the enemy in front of it, then steps back to its starting pose

consignes.idle: the wild boar stands on its four legs, snorts, lowers and raises its head, paws the ground with one front hoof, its bristly mane rises a little, the legs stay in place
consignes.move: the wild boar trots forward to the right with heavy steps in one full trotting cycle, head low, its legs moving in turn, it stays at the same place
consignes.attack: the wild boar lowers its head and lunges forward, thrusting its long tusks upward at the enemy in front of it, then steps back to its starting pose

archer-elfe.description: a slender wood elf archer standing, wearing a green and brown hooded cloak with the hood up, the face visible under the hood with fine features and pointed ears, light brown leather armour, a tall wooden longbow held in the left hand, a quiver of green-feathered arrows on the back, soft leather boots
archer-elfe.sujet: a slender hooded wood elf archer in a green cloak with a tall longbow, side view facing right
archer-elfe.notes: Forêt, niveau 3 : le meilleur tireur (tire deux fois), 1 case. Choix de l'utilisateur (2026-11-09) : elfe des bois encapuchonné. Corde de larc non tracée : il tient larc en travers du corps, la corde tracée lui barrait le visage (remarque de lutilisateur).

mouvements.idle: the hooded elf archer stands calmly holding its longbow, breathes slowly, turns its head to look around, its cloak moves slightly, the feet stay in place
mouvements.move: the hooded elf archer walks forward to the right in one full light walking cycle, holding its longbow in one hand, its cloak swaying, it stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the hooded elf archer takes an arrow from its quiver, nocks it, raises the longbow, draws the bowstring fully back to its cheek and releases it, then lowers the bow back to its starting pose

consignes.idle: the hooded elf archer reaches over its shoulder, takes one arrow from its quiver, looks at it closely, then puts it back in the quiver and stands calmly again, holding its longbow, the feet stay in place
consignes.move: the hooded elf archer walks forward to the right in one full clear walking cycle: its left foot lifts off the ground and steps forward, then its right foot lifts and steps forward, it holds its longbow in one hand, its cloak sways, it stays at the same place
consignes.attack: the hooded elf archer takes an arrow from its quiver, nocks it, raises the longbow, draws the bowstring fully back to its cheek and releases it, then lowers the bow back to its starting pose

cerf.description: a large majestic red-brown forest stag standing proudly on its four slender legs, huge wide many-pointed antlers, a thick darker mane of fur on its neck, a pale belly and white rump, alert head held high
cerf.sujet: a large red-brown stag with huge many-pointed antlers and a thick neck mane, standing proudly, side view facing right
cerf.notes: Forêt, niveau 4 : le rapide, bondit par-dessus troupes et obstacles, 1 case. Choix de l'utilisateur (2026-11-09) : grand cerf de la forêt.

mouvements.idle: the stag stands proudly on its four legs, its ears twitch, it lowers its head to graze for a moment, then raises its head high again and looks around, the legs stay in place
mouvements.move: the stag runs forward to the right in one full bounding gallop cycle, leaping with its front legs reaching forward and its hind legs pushing off, its antlers held high, it stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the stag lowers its head and its huge antlers and rams forward hard, then raises its head and steps back to its starting pose

consignes.idle: the stag stands proudly on its four legs, its ears twitch, it lowers its head to graze for a moment, then raises its head high again and looks around, the legs stay in place
consignes.move: the stag walks forward to the right at a calm stately walk in one full walking cycle, each of its four legs lifting and stepping forward in turn, no jumping, no running, all hooves stay close to the ground, its head and antlers held high, it stays at the same place
consignes.attack: the stag lowers its head down close to the ground, then sweeps its huge antlers upward from low to high in one powerful upward thrust, lifting its head high, then lowers it back to its starting pose

treant.description: a walking blossoming tree that looks like a real old tree, not a man: a thick gnarled oak trunk as its body, a large rounded crown of light green leaves dotted with pink and white blossoms on top, the base of the trunk splits into thick twisted roots used as legs, two crooked side branches used as arms with twig fingers, soft green moss and ivy on the bark, only a subtle face formed by knots in the bark with two small glowing green eyes, no human body, no human face
treant.sujet: a walking blossoming oak tree with root legs, branch arms and a big leafy crown with pink flowers, only two small glowing eyes in the bark, side view facing right
references: art-candidats/references/treant-L5-1-coupe.png::the same walking tree: keep exactly its design, colours, trunk, roots, arms and blossoms, but draw its whole large rounded crown of leaves fully visible above it (in this reference the top of the crown is cut off), leave empty space around it
treant.notes: Forêt, niveau 6 : le mur lent, résiste aux tirs, ses coups enracinent la cible, 1 case. Choix de l utilisateur (2026-11-09) : tréant en fleurs. Revu : plus arbre, moins humain (remarque de l utilisateur). Refait (2026-11-09) : la couronne de L5-1 était coupée en haut (cadre de génération trop petit) ; regénéré à 144 × 160 avec L5-1 en référence.

mouvements.idle: the walking tree stands still and sways gently in the wind, its crown of leaves and blossoms rustles, its branch arms move slowly, its roots stay in place
mouvements.move: the walking tree walks slowly forward to the right on its thick roots in one full heavy lumbering walking cycle, one root leg lifting and stepping forward after the other, its crown swaying, it stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the walking tree raises one heavy branch arm high and swings it down hard to smash the enemy in front of it, then slowly returns to its starting pose

consignes.idle: the walking tree shakes its big leafy crown strongly from left to right and back again several times, like an animal shaking its head, a few leaves and petals fall slowly from its crown to the ground, then it stands still again, its roots stay in place
consignes.move: the walking tree walks slowly forward to the right on its thick roots: one big root leg lifts off the ground and steps forward, then the other, heavy and lumbering, its crown swaying gently, it stays at the same place
consignes.attack: the walking tree lashes one long flexible branch arm forward like a whip, the branch stretching far in front of it, then pulls it back to its starting pose

druide.description: a stout, thickset old druid standing firmly, broad shoulders, a big round belly and thick strong arms under a heavy earthy brown robe with wide sleeves tied with a red belt, a long thick white beard and a wise stern face under a tall pointed brown hood, holding a tall pale gnarled wooden staff with a forked top on which a small grey-brown owl with yellow eyes is perched
druide.sujet: a stout thickset old bearded druid with broad shoulders in a heavy brown robe and tall pointed hood with a red belt, holding a pale gnarled staff with an owl perched on top, side view facing right
references: art-candidats/references/druid1.png::style and costume reference (classic 1990s strategy game druid: brown pointed hood, brown robe, red belt, white beard): keep this look, but draw it bigger and more detailed, do not copy its exact pose

art-candidats/references/druid2.png::concept reference only (old hooded druid, a gnarled pale staff with an owl perched on it): keep the owl on the staff, ignore its grey colours, its realistic modern style and its grey checkered background
druide.notes: Forêt, niveau 5 : tireur et soigneur (tire sans pénalité de distance, aura de soin), 1 case. D'après deux références de l'utilisateur (2026-11-09) : la robe brune à capuche pointue et ceinture rouge (druid1), le bâton noueux avec une chouette (druid2, converti de l'AVIF). Revu : plus trapu, plus épais (remarque de l'utilisateur). L10-3 regarde déjà à droite : pas de miroir (les feuilles d animation faites avec miroir ont été retournées).

mouvements.idle: the stout old druid stands holding his staff, slowly strokes his long white beard with his free hand, the owl on top of the staff turns its head and ruffles its feathers, the feet stay in place
mouvements.move: the stout old druid walks forward to the right slowly in one full walking cycle, leaning on his tall staff with each step, his heavy robe swaying, the owl stays perched on the staff, he stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the stout old druid raises his tall staff and points it forward toward the enemy in front of him, as if casting a spell, then lowers it back to his starting pose, the owl stays perched on the staff

consignes.idle: the stout old druid stands holding his staff, slowly strokes his long white beard with his free hand, the owl on top of the staff turns its head and ruffles its feathers, the feet stay in place
consignes.move: the stout old druid walks forward to the right slowly in one full walking cycle, leaning on his tall staff with each step, his heavy robe swaying, the owl stays perched on the staff, he stays at the same place
consignes.attack: the stout old druid raises his tall staff and points it forward toward the enemy in front of him, as if casting a spell, then lowers it back to his starting pose, the owl stays perched on the staff

gnome.notes: Tour, niveau 1 : un petit gnome qui répare les golems, 1 case. Deux styles comparés (2026-11-10, choix de l'utilisateur) : petit mage (lots L1 à L4, d'après ses références gnome1 et gnome2) et bricoleur (L5 à L8). Revu (2026-11-10) : le mage chauve, sans chapeau (lots L9 à L12).
gnome.description: a small old gnome wizard standing, short and stocky, completely bald with a shiny bald head and no hat, a long bushy white beard and moustache, big nose, big pointed ears, a long dark blue robe with wide sleeves tied with a leather belt, sandals, holding a gnarled wooden staff
gnome.sujet: a small bald old gnome wizard with no hat, a long white beard, big pointed ears, a blue robe and a wooden staff, side view facing right
references: art-candidats/references/gnome1.png::character reference (classic 1990s strategy game gnome mage: a small bald old man with a white beard in a long robe): keep the bald head and the beard, its simple bold retro look and small size, do not copy its colours or its raised-arms pose

mouvements.idle: the small bald gnome wizard stands leaning on his wooden staff, slowly strokes his long white beard with his free hand, blinks and looks around, the feet stay in place
mouvements.move: the small bald gnome wizard walks forward to the right with small quick steps in one full walking cycle, his staff tapping the ground with each step, his robe swaying, he stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the small bald gnome wizard grips his wooden staff with both hands, raises it and whacks it down hard in front of him, then steps back to his starting pose

consignes.idle: the small bald gnome wizard stands leaning on his wooden staff, slowly strokes his long white beard with his free hand, blinks and looks around, the feet stay in place
consignes.move: the small bald gnome wizard walks forward to the right with small quick steps in one full walking cycle, his staff tapping the ground with each step, his robe swaying, he stays at the same place
consignes.attack: the small bald gnome wizard grips his wooden staff with both hands, raises it and whacks it down hard in front of him, then steps back to his starting pose

gargouille.notes: Tour, niveau 2 : gargouille de pierre, vole, 1 case. Deux styles comparés (2026-11-10) : d'après les deux photos de l'utilisateur (L1 à L4), et une idée plus originale, la pierre fendue d'une lueur arcane bleue (L5 à L8). Pas d attente (statue immobile, choix de l utilisateur) ; vol depuis une pose en vol (move-4, bleu rendu gris) avec envol transform-1, 0,35 s par case ; attaque provisoire attack-13-gris (bond, coup des deux pieds, 16 images), À RETRAVAILLER (choix de l utilisateur).
gargouille.description: a stone gargoyle crouching on its clawed feet like on a cathedral ledge, a muscular hunched body of pale grey weathered limestone with cracks and chips, two small curved horns, pointed ears, a grinning demon face with deep eyes and fangs, long arms with clawed stone hands, two large carved stone wings folded on its back, awakened by magic: thin glowing pale blue arcane runes and cracks run across its stone body, its eyes glow faint blue, as if a spell inside animates the stone
gargouille.sujet: a crouching stone gargoyle with horns and folded stone wings, thin glowing blue arcane cracks and runes on its stone body, side view facing right

mouvements.idle: the stone gargoyle stays crouched on its clawed feet, slowly turns its horned head from side to side, its folded stone wings shift a little, it flexes its claws, the feet stay in place
mouvements.move: the stone gargoyle spreads its large stone wings wide and flies forward to the right, beating them heavily up and down in one full slow flapping cycle, its legs tucked under its body, it stays at the same place
mouvements.attack: the stone gargoyle springs forward from its crouch, half opens its wings and rakes hard with both clawed hands in front of it, then crouches back to its starting pose

consignes.idle: the stone gargoyle stays crouched on its clawed feet, slowly turns its horned head from side to side, its folded stone wings shift a little, it flexes its claws, the feet stay in place
consignes.move: the stone gargoyle flies in the air, its body leaning forward, beating its large stone wings heavily down and up in one full steady flapping cycle, its legs tucked under its belly, it stays at the same place in the air
consignes.attack: the stone gargoyle, crouching, spreads its large stone wings wide and leaps forward into the air, then in mid-air kicks hard forward with both clawed feet together, then flies back and lands crouched exactly in its starting place, its wings folding
consignes.transform: the stone gargoyle takes off: crouching on its clawed feet, it bends lower, spreads its large stone wings, leaps up and tilts its body forward until it is flying horizontally, its legs tucking under its belly, ending in a flying pose with the wings raised

golem-pierre.notes: Tour, niveau 3 : golem de pierre lent, 1 case. Trois styles essayés (2026-11-10, références de l'utilisateur) : le masque (L1 à L3), le grès (L4 à L6), sans tête, le visage dans la poitrine (L7 à L9). Choix (2026-11-11) : L8-1 (sans tête, visage dans la poitrine) à 56 px ; move-9, idle-9 (mange un caillou), attack-8-gris (coup de poing en avant). Gardé pour plus tard : attack-23-gris (charge du torse en avant, finit un peu en avant de sa place).
golem-pierre.description: a headless stone golem standing: a massive body of stacked grey stone blocks with no head at all, a huge grim face carved directly into the front of its chest, with deep eyes, a broad nose and a heavy frowning mouth, very thick stone arms with big fists, short stocky stone legs
golem-pierre.sujet: a headless stone golem with a huge grim face carved into its chest, thick stone arms and fists, side view facing right
references: art-candidats/references/golem3.png::concept reference (a huge grim face carved into a block of stone): put this kind of face on the chest of a headless golem body, ignore the ink drawing style and the frame

consignes.idle: crouches all the way down and touches the ground with one hand, picks up a small grey pebble, stands up, puts the pebble into the open mouth carved in its chest, chews, then stands still
consignes.move: walking slowly and heavily forward, a slow stomping stone gait
consignes.attack: leans its heavy body back, then charges two big steps forward and throws its whole torso far forward, chest first, like a battering ram, then walks back two steps to its starting place and stance

naga.notes: Tour, niveau 4 : la lame rapide, mi-femme mi-serpent, six bras armés (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : bleue (bijoux d'or, couronne), verte (casque en tête de cobra, queue verte au ventre jaune). Choix (2026-11-11) : L2-2 (bleue) à 66 px ; idle-2, move-5 (queue ondulante), attack-7-sb (arc de lame bleu vif effacé).
naga.description: a naga warrior woman: a blue-skinned woman from the waist up with six arms, each hand holding a curved scimitar, golden bracelets, armlets and a golden breastplate, a tall red and gold pointed crown, long black hair; from the waist down a long thick dark blue-green snake tail with a pale belly, coiled on the ground, no legs
naga.sujet: a blue-skinned six-armed naga woman with six curved swords, gold jewelry and crown, a coiled snake tail instead of legs, facing right
references: art-candidats/references/naga1.png::concept reference (a blue six-armed warrior goddess with curved swords): keep the six arms, the curved swords and the crown; she has no legs (a snake tail instead), ignore the dancing pose and the drawing style
art-candidats/references/naga2.png::colour and costume reference: keep the blue skin and the gold jewelry; she has no legs (a snake tail instead), ignore the painting style

art-candidats/references/naga4.png::body reference: from the waist down she is a long thick snake body coiled on the ground, no legs at all; ignore the cobra hoods behind her, the ink drawing style and the black and white

consignes.idle: sways gently on her coiled snake tail, slowly rubs two of her curved swords against each other to sharpen them, the tip of her tail flicks and shakes
consignes.move: slithers forward like a snake, her long snake body making big exaggerated S-shaped waves that travel from her waist to the tip of her tail, the coils clearly rising and sliding on the ground, her upper body upright and swaying a little, the six arms holding the swords ready
consignes.attack: leans forward on her snake tail and slashes at the enemy in front of her with her curved swords, her six arms striking one after another, then rises back to her stance

djinn.notes: Tour, niveau 5 : le soutien volant (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-11). Trois styles : la fumée d'or (L1 à L3), le féroce (L4 à L6), le djinn du ciel (idée de Claude, L7 à L9). Choix (2026-11-11) : L2-1 (fumée d'or) à 72 px ; idle-2, move-2 (penché en avant, la queue étirée), attack-2-r (fond en avant, coup de poing).
djinn.description: a djinn floating in the air: a purple-blue skinned muscular man from the waist up, a big green turban with a golden ornament, a long red beard, golden bracelets and armbands, pointed ears; from the waist down his body turns into a swirling tail of golden yellow smoke, no legs
djinn.sujet: a floating purple-blue djinn with a green turban, a red beard, gold bracelets and a golden smoke tail instead of legs, facing right
references: art-candidats/references/djinn1.png::concept and colour reference (a purple djinn with a green turban, a red beard and a golden smoke tail): keep these colours and this design, ignore the frame, the city and the ink engraving style

consignes.idle: floats in place, bobbing slowly up and down, arms crossed, his golden smoke tail swirling and curling gently
consignes.move: glides forward through the air, leaning forward, his golden smoke tail streaming and waving behind him
consignes.attack: swoops forward and strikes the enemy in front of him with both big fists, then floats back to his place

mage.notes: Tour, niveau 6 : le grand tireur (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-11 : pas de chapeau, grandes manches, vêtements amples, pas de bâton). Deux styles : brun (L1 à L3), vieux à barbe grise (L4 à L6). Choix (2026-11-11) : L3-1 (brun) à 76 px ; idle-2, move-5 (14 images/s), attack-5-r (les deux mains au ciel puis en avant) ; tir : un éclair bleu (« eclair »).
mage.description: a battle mage standing: a man with long black hair swept back and a short black beard, no hat, a very loose dark purple robe with huge wide sleeves, a long blue inner robe with a red sash and a golden collar, one bare hand raised forward ready to cast a spell, no staff, no weapon
mage.sujet: a bareheaded black-haired mage in a loose purple robe with huge sleeves over a blue inner robe, one hand raised, no staff, facing right
references: art-candidats/references/mage1.png::costume reference (a mage in a loose purple robe with very wide sleeves over a blue and red inner robe, casting from his bare hand): keep the loose robe, the wide sleeves, the colours and the bare head; ignore the lightning effect, draw no magic effect

consignes.idle: stands calmly, breathing slowly, his raised hand slowly turning and his fingers moving as if weaving a spell, the wide sleeves and the loose robe swaying gently
consignes.move: walking forward with steady steps, his feet stepping out from under the long robe one after the other, both arms swinging naturally back and forth with each step, the huge sleeves swaying
consignes.attack: raises both hands high above his head, palms open toward the sky, gathering power, then swings both hands forward toward the enemy to cast a spell, then lowers his arms back to his stance

references: art-candidats/references/geant-l9-2.png::design reference (our own earlier giant): keep his blue skin, black beard, golden circlet, white and gold greek tunic, stone bracers and greek column; but give him a lean natural body, NOT muscular, not bulky
geant.notes: Tour, niveau 7 : le gardien (le Titan, plus tard, lancera la foudre). Trois styles proposés par Claude (2026-11-11) : gardien de bronze (L1 à L3), géant des montagnes (L4 à L6), géant arcane (L7 à L9). L9 choisi pour le style (peau bleue, barbe, tunique grecque, colonne), mais trop musclé, stéréotypé : refait mince et digne (L10 à L13). Choix (2026-11-11) : L11-4 (mince, à la colonne) à 105 px ; attente move-1 (il ne bouge pas les pieds), transform-1 (la colonne sur l'épaule), marche move-5 (depuis l'épaule), attaque attack-5-r (frappe le sol).
geant.description: a huge arcane giant standing calmly: a tall dignified giant with natural proportions, a lean slender build, narrow waist, long arms and legs, NOT muscular, not a bodybuilder, like a noble greek statue or an old philosopher; blue skin, a full black beard and long black hair, a golden circlet on his brow, a long sleeveless white and gold greek tunic with a wide belt, carved stone bracers on his forearms, sandals, holding a carved greek stone column as a weapon
geant.sujet: a tall lean dignified blue-skinned giant with a black beard, a golden circlet, a white and gold greek tunic, holding a greek stone column, natural proportions, not muscular, facing right

consignes.idle: stands calmly and breathes slowly, his free hand slowly strokes his black beard, the stone column held still
consignes.move: walks forward with slow, long, dignified steps, the stone column resting across his shoulder, held with one hand, the long tunic swinging
consignes.attack: grabs the stone column with both hands, raises it high above his head, then slams it straight down onto the ground in front of him, then lifts it back to his stance
consignes.transform: grabs the stone column with both hands, lifts it and lays it across his right shoulder, then holds it there with one hand, standing upright

homme-lezard.notes: Donjon, niveau 1 : la masse bon marché (référence de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : lézard des marais (L1 à L3), lézard des cavernes (L4 à L6). Choix (2026-11-11) : L6-1 (lézard des cavernes, lance) à 46 px ; idle-3, move-5-r (la tête fixée sur toutes les images : le corps glissait), attack-2-r (éclat blanc de la pointe effacé).
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/homme-lezard.png::concept reference (a lean lizardman warrior with a spiky crest, a leather harness and a long tail): keep this design and this crouched fighting stance; ignore the black and white ink style
homme-lezard.description: a lean cave lizardman warrior standing in a crouched fighting stance: dark grey-blue scales, a pale grey belly, a crest of bone-white spikes on the head, small pale eyes, a long tail, a leather harness across the chest, holding a spear with a bone tip
homme-lezard.sujet: a lean grey-blue cave lizardman with a pale belly, a crest of bone spikes, a leather harness and a bone-tipped spear, facing right

consignes.idle: stays crouched and alert, breathing, his long tail slowly swaying from side to side, his head turning a little, the spear held ready
consignes.move: walks forward quickly, low and crouched like a lizard, his long tail swinging from side to side, the spear held ready, a smooth looping walk cycle that ends exactly in the starting pose
consignes.attack: draws back the spear, then lunges and thrusts it straight forward, then pulls it back to his stance
